notes.title: Servants of Harverst Wish 1.10a Final Patchnotes
notes.content:
1.10a (2023/07/30)
	- Added Easy Extra (18 new spell IDs added)
	- Draco Meteor - "Meteor Shatter" spell nerfed (Replays stay functional)
	- Adressed an issue where the spellcard bonus on specific cards could go below zero, resulting in Bonus Failed even if the spellcard was captured
	- Adressed an issue where infinite harvest items could be spawned by pointblanking a boss in a very specific frame
	- Various improvements and bugfixes
	- Internal save data and replay version control system

Known 1.10a Issues: 
	- Older Ex replays show the wrong difficulty in replay select. In the stage, the correct difficulty and replay will play.
	- Replays for Nonspells are broken. This is scheduled to be fixed in 1.10b

notes.title: Servants of Harvest Wish v.1.10a Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Servants of Harvest Wish will update to v.1.10a this Sunday (30th July). The biggest feature to name is easy extra, an easier version of the extra stage, allowing newer players to experience the full fight against Mamo.
Please note that the difficulty of Easy Extra, despite the name, is around normal mode difficulty, being in line with the difficulty jump from the normal game to extra, but for players who prefer the easy difficulty mode.
Furthermore, there will be some adjustments to menus, UI and bugfixes. You can find the preliminary patch notes below:

1.10a (2023/07/30)
	- Added Easy Extra (18 new spell IDs added)
	- Draco Meteor - "Meteor Shatter" spell nerfed (Replays stay functional)
	- Adressed an issue where the spellcard bonus on specific cards could go below zero, resulting in Bonus Failed even if the spellcard was captured
	- Adressed an issue where infinite harvest items could be spawned by pointblanking a boss in a very specific frame
	- Various improvements and bugfixes
	- Internal save data and replay version control system

Known 1.10a Issues: 
	- Older Ex replays show the wrong difficulty in replay select. In the stage, the correct difficulty and replay will play.
	- Replays for Nonspells are broken. This is scheduled to be fixed in 1.10b

Patch 1.10b is then scheduled to release a few weeks after 1.10a and will include further bugfixes, but no new content. Thank you for enjoying our game! :)
